data.name: Ghost Ship: Pirate King(Gather)
data.description: Board the Ghost Ship and defeat the Pirate King for a chance to find buried treasure.

objectives.description: The ghost ship crosses the moon trailing green fire, and the sea goes quiet beneath it. Tonight it anchors close enough to board. Choose your way in.

nextObjectiveId.text: Hail the ship and ask for parley

objectives.description: The Ghostly Bosun waits at the top of the gangplank with the deck watch, powder crates stacked at the rail behind him. He does not ask your business.
Break the deck watch: the Ghostly Bosun and his powder stores.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The cold water takes you and the ship waits, patient as the tide. Board again.
Climb the anchor chain hand over hand before the watch turns. Gather your footing on the wet iron links.
You slip through the hull breach into the bilge, ankle-deep in black water. Something vast unfolds from the weed-wrapped timbers: the Ghostly Bilge Horror.
The Ghostly Bilge Horror rises from the black water.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The Horror drags you under the black water and feeds you back out the breach. Climb again.

A tall figure of pale lantern light salutes from the rail: the Ghostly Herald. 'Answer true and walk aboard oathbound. Answer false and answer my blade. What does every sailor keep that the sea always takes?'
'True.' The Herald steps aside and the crew parts before you, all the way to the helm. 'You walk aboard oathbound. The King will know.'
'False.' The Herald draws a slender dueling blade and salutes. 'Then the duel is your answer.'
The Ghostly Herald salutes and begins the duel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The Herald's blade finds you three times and he lets the sea take you, unimpressed. Hail the ship again.
The deck stretches impossibly wide under tattered black sails. Three ways forward: the chart-lit captain's quarters, the stairs down to the gold-breathing hold, or the long walk to the helm.
The Ghostly Navigator looks up from charts of impossible seas, ink swirling off his hands like living shadow. The coded map you need hangs at his belt.
The Ghostly Navigator redraws the room around you.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: Ink and shadow blind you, and you wake back on the deck. The quarters wait.
You cut the coded map free. Landmarks you know, drawn wrong on purpose, and a riddle inked along the margin. The dig site is out there under the moon.
Drifts of gold coin rise taller than a man. The Ghostly Quartermaster steps between you and the crates, coin-weighted maul on his shoulder, ledger chained to his belt. 'Nothing leaves unaccounted.'
The Ghostly Quartermaster hefts the coin-weight maul.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The maul writes you into the ledger and the hold spits you out. Descend again.
The King's retinue holds the helm: two Ghostly Bosuns stand side by side before a crowned throne of ship timber, mirror-perfect down to the knots in their lashes.
The retinue bars the last steps to the throne.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The retinue holds and the helm stays the King's. Walk it again.
Even the oathbound walk through the retinue. Two Ghostly Bosuns bar the last steps to the throne, and neither bows.
The retinue bars the way, oath or no oath.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The retinue holds, oath or no oath. Walk it again.
The margin riddle reads: 'Where the cliff drinks and the stone watches, dig beneath the watcher's shadow.' Three coves lie under the moon.

nextObjectiveId.text: The cove beneath the stone shrine
The cove with the split cliff
The open beach past the reef

objectives.description: You dig until your arms burn. Rusted cutlasses, crab shells, no chest. The watcher's shadow falls elsewhere.
Sand and reef and nothing buried but a dead man's anchor. Read the riddle again.
Dig beneath the stone watcher's shadow before the tide turns.
Your shovel strikes iron, and the beach itself stands up. The Ghostly Guardian erupts from the sand, shell and reef spike crouched around your prize.
The Ghostly Guardian erupts from the sand.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The Guardian buries you to the neck and settles back over the chest. The dig site remains.
The Guardian collapses into wet sand and the chest beneath is iron-bound and heavy with promise. X marks the spot.
You read the dead man's map true and took the treasure from the sand itself.
The hold is yours. Crates you can carry sit in the open. Behind them, a black iron vault hums with something worse. Fortune favors the brave.

nextObjectiveId.text: Grab what you can carry and go

objectives.description: You shoulder a crate and make for the gangplank. The Ghostly Bosun stands at the rail one last time, hook in hand.
The Bosun bars the gangplank one last time.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The Bosun hooks you back aboard by the collar. The rail is right there.
You spill onto the beach with your crate as the ship slides back into the dark. A modest haul, and your neck intact.
Not every fortune is worth the vault that guards it. You took the sure thing.
The lock breaks and the hold goes cold. The Ghostly First Mate steps out of the vault's dark behind twin gale cleavers, coat snapping in a wind that should not exist below decks.
The Ghostly First Mate steps out of the vault's dark.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The storm folds you in half and the vault seals itself to wait. Crack it again.
The storm dies with him. The vault stands open, and what the King hid from his own crew is yours.
You woke what greed keeps chained and beat it anyway. Fortune favors the brave.
The Pirate King rises from the crowned throne, green fire guttering along his cutlass. 'Bold. The sea remembers bold.'
The Pirate King rises from the crowned throne.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The King breaks you against the wheel and the crew throws you to the sea, laughing. The helm waits.
The King kneels, green fire dying along the blade. 'Take it, then. Three hundred years I gathered it for someone worth losing to.'
You walked the longest deck straight to the throne and took the hoard from the King himself.
The King rises, and the Herald's word arrives before you do. 'Oathbound. Then you get the King the crew remembers.' The green fire around him turns white.

nextObjectiveId.text: Face the King at his full fury

objectives.description: The green fire turns white. The King the crew remembers steps down from the throne.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The enraged King breaks you against the wheel, then waits for the sigil to knit you back together. An oathbound duel does not end until one of you yields. He has not.

The white fire dies and the King kneels, laughing through broken teeth. 'Oath kept.' He presses the hoard's key into your hand himself. The best of his treasure was always reserved for the one who earned it.
You answered true, dueled with honor, and broke the King at his strongest. No richer night exists aboard the Ghost Ship.

data.name: The Drowned Fleet
data.description: Board the Drowned Fleet, a raiding armada of water-ninja who fight behind heavy absorb. Learn to afterburn through the churn and bring down Tidelord Kaisei on the flagship.
data.successDescription: The Drowned Fleet lies broken beneath the waves. Tidelord Kaisei is defeated and the coast is safe once more.

objectives.description: The Drowned Fleet has come raiding. Its tide-ninja fight inside a churn of water that drinks your blows: when one raises its absorb, hard hits only feed it, while afterburn lands after the absorb step in the exchange and gets clean damage through. Their ships ride the swell off the coast ahead.
You close on the outermost picket skiff. Drowned Fleet deckhands turn as your boat scrapes the hull. Board it and fight your way toward the flagship.
A lone Tide Treader meets you at the rail. No absorb here, so burst it down.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: Two Treaders rush the deck, fighting in the open water.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Riptide Adept pulls water around itself beside a Treader. Afterburn the one that absorbs.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: Two Riptide Adepts churn the deck. Stick an afterburn on each rather than swinging into the absorb.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Maelstrom Adept holds the helm, renewing its absorb as it fights.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: The tide throws you off the skiff. Board it again and push through.
The skiff is yours. You leap to the War Junk, where nearly every tide-ninja fights behind an absorb and Maelstroms stiffen the line.
Two Riptide Adepts open behind their churning water.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Riptide absorbs while a Treader presses in the open. Choose your target.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Maelstrom Adept anchors two Riptides, all of them absorbing.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: Two renewing absorbs now, Maelstrom and Riptide. Let your afterburns do the work.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: The Deepwater Warden guards the gangway behind a heavy, near-constant absorb.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: The deck pitches and washes you back to the gangplank. The skiff is behind you, so press on.
The Warden falls. Ahead lies the flagship: Maelstroms everywhere, and Tidelord Kaisei waiting on the stern deck.
Two Maelstrom Adepts hold the foredeck, absorbs renewing in turn.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Maelstrom and a Riptide wall the mast.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: Two more Maelstroms, absorb up the moment your pressure drops.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: A Deepwater Warden and a Maelstrom form a gauntlet of absorbs before the stern.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: The deck clears at last. Tidelord Kaisei rises on a constant churn of water that swallows ordinary damage whole. Burst will only feed it. Afterburn lands after the absorb, so it gets through.
Tidelord Kaisei drowns the deck in an absorb you cannot out-hit. Afterburn it down.
objectives.drawDescription: The boarding stalls and the tide washes you back.
objectives.failDescription: You are thrown from the deck and must board again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat off the deck and must board it again.

objectives.description: The stern deck washes you back to the gangway. Recover, then take the flagship.
Tidelord Kaisei's churn finally fails and the Drowned Fleet goes still. The armada is broken and the coast is safe.
Tidelord Kaisei drags you under and the Drowned Fleet sails on. The coast is lost.
The skiff pitches as another Drowned raider hauls onto the deck.
Water sluices off the boards. The next of the fleet steps up.
A ragged cry rises from the hull. More raiders close in.
The deck clears for a heavier tread. A veteran of the skiff bars your way.
You drop onto the junk's deck. A patrol turns to meet you.
Rigging creaks overhead as the next raiders form up.
The deck narrows. More of the fleet press in.
The rabble falls back, and the junk's warden takes the deck.
The flagship rail is slick with spray. The next guard advances.
Lanterns swing wild in the storm. More raiders answer the call.
The deck opens toward the stern. The last of the guard steps forward.
